name: R030-curse-last-move-ai-replacement
why: The AI picks its replacement after a faint with a damage pass that uses the last move of the turn (AI_CalcDmg with gCurrentMove, battle_ai_switch_items.c:775-779); when that move is Curse (type ???) the damage formula gives 0. The player's Skarmory (set 482) badly poisons the opponent's Dugtrio (set 468, fast and frail, no healing). The player switches to Snorlax (set 556, Speed 30) and uses Curse every turn, so Curse is always the last move of the turn. When Dugtrio faints from the poison at the end of a turn, the AI scores its replacements: Milotic (559) and Electrode (492) have no Fighting move, so no candidate has a super-effective move against Snorlax, the type pass finds nothing and the damage pass runs with Curse as the current move.

onHold.result: no hit in lab seeds 60000..60043 (box hunt rrh1). Engine runs fine; the AI replacement never reaches the damage pass with Curse. In seed 60019 Dugtrio (102 HP) takes toxic ticks 6,12,18,24 but Dugtrio kills Snorlax first (216 -> 128 -> 0 in two Earthquakes), so the player has no Curse user left when the poison faint comes. The design needs a sturdier Curse user or faster poison.
